body:
# ⚔️ UltraEnchants - Mod Fabric 1.20.4

> **40 custom enchantments** to turn your Minecraft into an RPG!


[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-blue)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1%20→%201.21.1-green)](https://minecraft.net)

[![site](https://img.shields.io/badge/mods%20(by%20me)-web-pink)](https://lefilou20contact-ai.github.io/Blockname_/)

---⚔️ UltraEnchants — 40 custom enchantments for Fabric 1.20+

UltraEnchants adds 40 brand-new enchantments across all equipment slots: sword, bow, crossbow, armor, tools, and boots. Every enchantment has unique effects that don't exist in vanilla — lifesteal, chain lightning, vein miner, lava walking, execute on low-health enemies, and much more.

---

## Why install UltraEnchants?

Vanilla Minecraft's enchantment system is limited and repetitive. UltraEnchants turns your gear into a full RPG system where every piece can serve a strategic role in combat or exploration. Whether you play solo survival, on a PvP server, or in a modpack, the enchantments integrate naturally without breaking vanilla balance.

- All enchantments are obtained in-game (enchanting table, librarian, loot)
- No commands required, no complex interface
- Visual feedback with particles and lightning effects in combat
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer servers

---

## 🗡️ Sword (10 enchantments)

- **Lifesteal** I–V — Steal up to 25% of the damage dealt as health
- **Thunderstrike** I–III — Chance to strike lightning on the target
- **Soul Rend** I–IV — Bonus damage against undead and players
- **Berserker** I–III — The lower your health, the more damage you deal
- **Execute** I–IV — Up to ×3 damage if the target is below 25% health ✨
- **Venom Blade** I–III — Applies amplified poison on every hit
- **Vampirism** I–III — Automatic regeneration during combat
- **Bleed** I–III — Slows and inflicts bleed particles on the target
- **Graviton** I–III — Launches the enemy into the air
- **Inferno** I–IV — Sets the enemy on fire far longer than Fire Aspect

## 🏹 Bow & Crossbow (8 enchantments)

- **Sniper** I–III — Bonus damage based on distance traveled
- **Explosive Arrow** I–III — Arrows explode on impact (up to 3-block radius) ✨
- **Chain Lightning** I–III — Lightning arcs that jump across nearby enemies
- **Homing** I–II — Arrows automatically steer toward nearby mobs ✨
- **Wither Arrow** I–II — Applies Wither II to the target
- **Iceshot** I–III — Freezes the target (slowness + mining fatigue)
- **Multishot+** I–III — Fires up to 4 arrows in a spread (crossbow)
- **Bounce** I–III — Arrows ricochet off solid surfaces

## 🛡️ Armor (9 enchantments)

- **Thorns+** I–V — Reflects up to 50% of incoming damage
- **Guardian** I–III — Reduces all damage by 5% per level
- **Angel Wings** I–III — Slows your fall while holding Shift ✨
- **Magnet** I–III — Automatically attracts items and XP
- **Speed Boost** I–III — Permanent Speed effect (boots)
- **Ironhide** I–IV — Permanent Resistance I to IV (chestplate)
- **Reflect** I–III — Up to 50% chance to reflect an incoming arrow
- **Wither Proof** I — Complete immunity to the Wither effect ✨
- **Undying+** I–III — Saves you from death with powerful healing ✨

## ⛏️ Tools (7 enchantments)

- **Vein Miner** I–III — Breaks up to 32 connected identical blocks at once
- **Auto-Smelting** I — Mined ores are automatically smelted on drop
- **Magnetic Pick** I–III — Pulls drops toward you in an expanding radius
- **Explosive Mine** I–III — Mining explosion with no self-damage ✨
- **Lumberjack** I–II — Chops the entire tree in one swing (axe)
- **Replant** I — Automatically replants crops after harvesting (hoe)
- **Titan Pick** I–V — Mining speed up to ×10

## 👟 Boots (4 enchantments)

- **Spring** I–IV — Permanent Jump Boost + reduced fall damage
- **Lava Walker** I–II — Walk on lava ✨
- **Dash** I–III — Directional speed dash (double-tap Shift)
- **Anti-Gravity** I–II — Completely cancels fall damage

## ✨ Special (2 enchantments)

- **Curse of Decay** — Item loses durability 3× faster
- **Soulbound** — Item stays in your inventory on death ✨

*✨ = Treasure enchantment (librarian trades, loot chests, or fishing only)*

---

## ⚠️ Before you download

> **Fabric API is required.** The mod will not load without it.

- Minecraft **1.20.4** only (Java Edition)
- Loader: **Fabric ≥ 0.15.9**
- Required dependency: **Fabric API 0.96.11+1.20.4**
- **Server-side only** — clients do not need the mod installed
- OptiFine is not supported — use **Sodium** instead
- Translations included: 🇬🇧 English and 🇫🇷 French
